title: Sign-in, demo accounts and role landing pages
story: The portal has no role picker. A person types an email and a password, and the server decides from the account which portal to open: the staff workspace, the Dean portal, the Faculty portal or the Student portal. This case shows that real typed sign-in, the demo-only shortcut panel that a presenter can use instead, the way a demo student is reset to a clean state, and the page each role lands on.
Demo accounts exist only in demonstration mode. With demonstration mode off, the sign-in page is only the two-field form. Every demo account uses the same password, DemoPass123!.

parts.title: Part A - A real typed sign-in

steps.text: Open the portal address in a new browser window. The **Sign in** form is shown with the **Email** and **Password** fields empty; nothing is pre-filled. The heading reads Graduate School Lifecycle Portal and the note under it says the screens you see depend on the role your account holds.

shots.caption: The sign-in page: empty Email and Password fields, and the collapsed Demo accounts panel marked Demo mode.

steps: Type the email staff@usls.edu.ph and a wrong password, then select **Sign in**. The page stays on the sign-in screen and shows the message **Incorrect email or password.** The portal does not open for a wrong password.

steps.text: Expect the form to show the red message only. Note that this attempt is refused by the server, not by the page.

shots.caption: A wrong password is refused with the message Incorrect email or password.

steps.text: Type staff@usls.edu.ph in **Email** and DemoPass123! in **Password**. The password is masked while you type.

shots.caption: Credentials typed into the empty form.

steps.text: Select **Sign in**. The staff workspace opens on the **Dashboard**. The top bar shows Grace Fernandez - Graduate School Staff, and the left sidebar lists Overview, Records, Lifecycle Workflows, Standalone Processes and Monitoring & support.

shots.caption: The staff landing page: the Graduate School Overview dashboard with the role-specific sidebar.

steps.text: Select the bell icon in the top bar. The **Notifications** panel opens. In this run it reads **You have no notifications.** because nothing was due for the staff account; reminders and request updates appear here as they occur.

shots.caption: The notification bell open on the staff dashboard.

steps.text: Select the sign-out icon (tooltip **Sign out**) at the right of the top bar. The portal returns to the sign-in page and the session is closed.

shots.caption: After sign-out, the sign-in page is shown again.

parts.title: Part B - The demo accounts panel and demo student reset
parts.intro: This panel is shown only when the server runs in demonstration mode. It lists every ready-made account so a presenter does not have to remember emails. Nothing is filled in until a button is chosen.

steps.text: Select **Demo accounts** on the sign-in page to expand it. The panel shows the shared demo password, the seven staff, Dean, Faculty and Student accounts (each with **Fill form** and **Sign in**), and the **Student workflow demos** grouped in the lifecycle order: 1 Student Handoff, 2 Course Adjustments, 3 Enrollment, 4-6 Research, Panel & Defense, 7 Practicum, 8 Graduation, then the standalone groups Leave of Absence, Readmission, AWOL & Residency and Withdrawal.

shots.caption: The expanded Demo accounts panel: staff and role accounts, and the workflow demo student groups.

steps: **Fill form** copies an account into the two sign-in fields (and reveals the password) so it can be submitted with the normal **Sign in** button. The **Sign in** button inside the panel signs in at once. Both are demonstration conveniences; the typed sign-in in Part A is the same sign-in.

steps.text: Open the group **1 · Student Handoff** and select the red **Reset** button beside Anton Bautista. The browser asks for confirmation (Reset Anton Bautista's Student-Handoff demo?); confirm it. A green notice at the bottom of the panel confirms that the demo was reset and the student is ready to begin again.

shots.caption: Anton Bautista reset: the green notice confirms the Student-Handoff demo data was cleared.

steps: Use this reset before any demonstration case that changes a student, so the case starts from a known state. Reset clears only that student's submissions, messages, tasks and staff actions for that workflow.

parts.title: Part C - Where each role lands
parts.intro: Each account below was signed in by typing its email and DemoPass123! into the empty form. The server, not the form, decides the portal.

steps.text: Sign in as **academic@usls.edu.ph**. The portal opens on the **Monitoring Sheet**. The sidebar is shortened: Reports; Students, Faculty, Monitoring Sheet, Enrollment Class List; lifecycle workflows 2 to 8 (there is no 1 · Student Handoff); AWOL & Residency as the only standalone process; and Work Queue, Policy Assistant and Business Rules. There is no Leave of Absence, Readmission, Withdrawal Requests, Activity Log or Policy Documents entry.

shots.caption: Academic Coordinator (Dr. Ramon Alvarez): landing on the Monitoring Sheet.

steps.text: Sign in as **research@usls.edu.ph**. The portal opens on **Graduation Endorsement**. The sidebar is limited to Monitoring Sheet; 4 · Research Gate, 5 · Panel Matching, 6 · Defense Scheduling and 8 · Graduation; and Work Queue, Policy Assistant and Business Rules.

shots.caption: Research Coordinator (Dr. Sofia Mendoza): landing on Graduation Endorsement.

steps.text: Sign in as **admin@usls.edu.ph**. The portal opens on the Dashboard with the full staff sidebar (the same entries as the staff account). The top bar reads System Administrator - Administrator.

shots.caption: Administrator: the same full workspace as staff, for review.

steps.text: Sign in as **dean@usls.edu.ph**. The **Dean Portal** opens on the Dean Dashboard (decisions waiting, by process). Its sidebar has an **Approvals** group (Approvals Queue, Course Adjustments, Leave of Absence, Readmission, AWOL & Residency, Withdrawal Requests, Practicum Reports, Graduation Endorsement, Admission & Coursework Reports) and a Monitoring & support group (Reports & Analytics, Decision History, Policy Assistant, Business Rules).

shots.caption: Dean (Dr. Manuel Villaruz): the Dean Dashboard and approvals navigation.

steps.text: Sign in as **liwayway.bautista@usls.edu.ph**. The **Faculty Portal** opens on a welcome dashboard. The sidebar has Advising & research (My Advisees, Signatures & Endorsements, Panel Assignments & Papers, Panel Invitations, Defense Schedule, My Calendar, My Availability, Verdicts), Teaching (Assigned Classes) and Support (Policy Assistant, Business Rules). The footer says a faculty member sees only the advisees and panels assigned to them.

shots.caption: Faculty (Dr. Liwayway Bautista): the Faculty Portal dashboard.

steps.text: Sign in as **student@usls.edu.ph**. The **Student Portal** opens on the Dashboard with a welcome for Miguel Yu, 2260004, MAED. The sidebar groups are Overview, Academics, Research, Requests and Support.

shots.caption: Student (Miguel Yu): the Student Portal dashboard.

notes: There is no Registrar login. The Registrar is an external office; the platform only exports and imports files for it.

Staff, Academic Coordinator, Research Coordinator and Administrator share the staff workspace; the sidebar is trimmed to what each role may open. The Dean, Faculty and Student accounts have their own portals.
The demo accounts panel and the reset button exist only in demonstration mode and are not a production feature. The shared password is a demonstration value.
After a refused sign-in the form fields are cleared; the message stays on screen.
